drivingQuestion: Why not tie the whole strip to the rock?

segments.he: מֶה הָיָה עוֹשֶׂה — חוֹלֵק לָשׁוֹן שֶׁל זְהוֹרִית. וְנִקְטְרֵיהּ כּוּלֵּיהּ בְּסֶלַע? כֵּיוָן דְּמִצְוָה בְּשָׂעִיר, דִּילְמָא קָדֵים וּמַלְבִּין וּמִיַּתְּבָא דַּעְתֵּיהּ.
segments.en: § It was taught in the mishna: «What did» the person designated to dispatch the goat «do» there? «He divided a strip of crimson» into two parts, half of the strip tied to the rock, and half of it tied between the two horns of the goat. The Gemara asks: «Let him tie the whole» strip «to the rock.» The Gemara answers: «Since it is a mitzva» to push «the goat» from the cliff. If he tied the whole strip to the rock, «perhaps it would turn white quickly, and his mind would be eased» with the knowledge that the sins of the Jewish people had been forgiven. He would then not fulfill the mitzva of pushing the goat off the cliff. He therefore tied part of it between the horns of the goat and looked to see if it became white. Once he was actively involved with the goat, he would remember to push it off the cliff.
